lead: Kamini Kaushal was a film actor, born on 24 February 1927 in Lahore.
She died on 13 November 2025 in Mumbai at the age of 98.
She has 19 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Lifetime Achievement Award and Filmfare Award for Best Actress.
This profile collects the Kamini facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Kamini Kaushal — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Kamini Kaushal was born on 24 February 1927 in Lahore, and holds citizenship of British Raj and India.
Public records name her father, Shiv Ram Kashyap.
She received her education at Government College University and Kinnaird College for Women.
She is recorded as speaking Hindi.
